_provenance: Every `Language` row a modern (tv.plex.*) agent carries at /system/agents, per X-Plex-Language, captured from the plexlab reference (Plex 1.43.4) on 2026-09-15 and confirmed identical on zen (1.42.2) for none/en/de/ja. Read from the XML, which is the only form that carries every row: the JSON writes them as repeated KEYS and a parser keeps one (cycle 21). All six modern agents share one list. The empty key is the NO-HEADER default and is NOT English -- each language is named in itself there, and an UNRECOGNISED language falls back to it rather than to English, unlike every other localised string. The ORDER is the reference's own, which collates by the localised title; it is stored rather than modelled, because ICU collation is deliberately not implemented here.
